name: playwright_browse
description:
Render a web page using Playwright (JS-capable browser) and return the extracted text.

- Use this for JS-heavy pages that normal HTTP scraping can’t read.
- Provide `query` to extract only the relevant parts (uses Emi’s existing `scraper` agent).
- Set `dry_run: true` to validate orchestration without launching a browser (good for tests).
arguments_prompt:
Provide arguments for the `playwright_browse` tool.

Arguments:
- url (required): page to open
- query (optional): what to extract from the page (leave empty to return full page text)
- wait_until (optional): Playwright navigation wait strategy (default: "domcontentloaded")
- timeout_ms (optional): navigation timeout in ms (default: 30000)
- post_wait_ms (optional): extra wait after navigation in ms (default: 0)
- max_chars (optional): truncate output to this many chars (default: 50000)
- dry_run (optional): if true, do NOT launch a browser (default: false)

Example:
{"url": "https://example.com", "query": "Find hours and phone number", "dry_run": true}
